Northern Tulcea warned on 4 November; no Romanian entry reported

4 November 2026 · Northern Tulcea · 4 November RO-Alert without reported entry

Official warning; no Romanian airspace entry reported

Northern Tulcea received RO-Alert at 10:57 on 4 November after a radar target was detected north of Vîlcove in Ukraine. Two F-16s launched from Borcea.

MApN reported no Romanian airspace entry. This selected alert is separate from the overnight 2–3 November warning; the map point represents the warning area.
